tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: The signed passport of a product (a Global Trade Item Number, GTIN) or a retail banner (market/banner, e.g. FR/Carrefour): which hub holds its record, where it is cleared, its compliance records, who lists it, where the payment door is. Read live from the GSC hubs on every call; the first call issue

tools.name: list_passports
tools.description: The passports on the register: ids, kinds, markets, versions and issue times, newest first. No bodies. Filter by kind (gtin or banner), market, or issued since a time; paginated.

tools.name: verify_passport
tools.description: Check a passport: is the signature valid, is the chain of versions intact, how old is the stamp, was any section not read. Verifies from the published key at /.well-known/jwks.json.
